title: ushasi-npc-spectro-pxrf
summary: A Jupyter Notebook project for augmenting a soil pXRF/spectroradiometer dataset (organic carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus measurements) with synthetic rows. generate_data.ipynb builds an SDV SingleTableMetadata schema and fits CTGANSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer to produce 500 synthetic samples each from the SDV single-table API.
